original.heading: External resources are outside this parody
paragraphs: This action points to a document, login or external resource on the original website. The parody does not provide access to those resources.
For official documents or services, visit the institute’s official website directly. This hackathon project cannot process applications, payments or requests.

pirate.heading: That scroll went overboard
paragraphs: You clicked a document, login or outside link from the real website. We do not carry those on this ship. A sea monster runs the filing department and it does not share.
For official documents and services, please visit the institute’s official website. This parody cannot take applications, payments or requests.
